answers.q1: Mostly one white card, but two pieces feel detached: the small dark pill toolbar (pause/chat/expand/more/stop) floats above and overlaps the top edge of the card like a separate video-call control widget, not part of the card itself; and the 'AIが見ている資料' caption sits below the card's bottom edge, outside its border, as a loose floating label rather than a footer inside the surface.
answers.q2: Only loosely. I can see it's recording a meeting called '14:50 の会議' and that it is 'listening', but there's no visible app/platform name, participant list, or calendar link telling me which real meeting or call this is. 'AI が見ている資料' implies some reference document is in play, but it doesn't say what that document is.
answers.q3: It is actively recording audio (録音中, timer at 00:02) and waiting for someone to speak — the transcript panel says 'まだ発話がありません' (no speech yet) and the decisions/todo sections both show placeholder 'waiting' text, so the whole card is in a not-yet-populated listening state.
answers.q4: The recording indicator and elapsed timer (録音中 00:02) paired with the meeting title '14:50 の会議' — that's the only thing telling you this app is live and what it's currently doing.
answers.q5: 'AI が見ている資料' is vague and floats outside the card with no visible resource name attached, so it raises a question (what resource?) without answering it. The floating dark toolbar overlapping the card's top edge reads as an unrelated control strip rather than part of the same surface. The three empty-state lines (発話なし/決まったこと待ち/やること待ち) are repetitive but expected for a fresh recording.

weaknesses.what: The dark pill toolbar at top overlaps and floats above the card boundary instead of being visually merged into it
weaknesses.fix: Dock the toolbar inside the card's top edge (shared background/border) instead of letting it float above and overlap the corner radius

weaknesses.what: No indication of which real meeting/app/participants this is beyond a generic time-based title
weaknesses.fix: Surface the source (calendar event name, app being captured, or participant names) near the title

weaknesses.what: Large empty transcript and summary areas with only placeholder waiting-text make the first screen feel sparse/barren
weaknesses.fix: Use a lighter-weight empty state (e.g. single subtle hint) so the empty regions don't dominate the layout
